notes.title: Version 1.9 Now Live!
notes.content: [p]Hey there,[/p][p]the release date is drawing in close![/p][p]There will be a new trailer showcasing the game and revealing the release date.[/p][p]The trailer is coming out soon! And don't worry the release is still planned for 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the newest changes & tweaks:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patchnotes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemies received a visual overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Senzela Forest Boss[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked CuPy visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Added Parallax Backgrounds to multiple levels[/p][/*][*][p]Silenced MP now has much more ammo capacity[/p][/*][*][p]Streamlined Senzela Forest crossroad section[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new transition screen between Paredia West & the Casino[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new transition screen when player gets consumed by a void monster in the sewers[/p][/*][*][p]Sewer switch lamps are now visually more obvious[/p][/*][*][p]Many doors are now visually more obvious[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the behaviour & visuals of the laserbeam in Senzela Forest[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could revive themselves in a scripted death in the sewers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the train cutscene in Strato Terminal would always play again[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where story acts would not properly load when pressing "continue"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues related to minecarts[/p][/*][*][p]Many more Bug fixes[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Let me know about any feedback, you've got![/p][p]- SoulPixel[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.6 Now Live!
notes.content:

notes.title: Version 1.5.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
Heyy!

Thank you to everyone who is enjoying the Casa De Diamantes Demo!

Here is a final patch before the Steam Next Fest.

[b]Patchnotes:[/b]

- The Player can now perform a Double Jump after falling
- Added Diamonds to the Bartender Menu
- New Soundeffects
- Tweaked Spring Ladder Mechanic
- Tweaked Visuals of Upgrade Screen
- Increased overall Particle Count
- Tweaked multiple Senzela Forest Level
- Fixed an issue with arena gates not closing properly
- Fixed an issue where starting a new save file would not properly delete the previous save file
- Many more Bug Fixes

Have fun!

- SoulPixel

notes.title: Version 1.4.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Welcome Back!

Here is a new update for the demo just in time for the june steam event.
Thanks to all the players who have tried out the game!
I'm trying to include as much player feedback as possible.

It seems like Casa De Diamantes could release this year. I don't want to make any promises but overall development is going smoothly
This update brings a lot of new features, quality of life improvements and bug fixes.
Here are all the changes.

[b]Patchnotes:[/b]

- Added the Starfarer Skin
- Reworked Walking Animation
- Reworked Cutscenes & Dialog
- Changed Secret Rewards
- Added Mouse Controls to all Menus
- Added Skip Dialog Button to dialogs
- Added Player Dropshadow
- Reworked Slotblocks
- Added Diamond & Neural Key Indicator to HUD
- Increased Explosive Range for Enemies only
- Tweaked Shotgun Upgrades
- Added Indicator to finished Arenas
- Added Gamma Setting & Increased overall Game Brightness
- Added many soundeffects
- Many Bug Fixes

Have fun!

- SoulPixel

notes.title: Version 1.3.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Well, hello there!

Thank you so much for your patience!
First of all, the demo reached 15000 Downloads!
I cannot thank you guys enough for this. This means a lot to me!
I hope you are ready for the final release somewhere in the future.

Casa De Diamantes is moving along very well and I just wanted to update the Demo with some new stuff.
This update does not only bring bug fixes. There are also 2 new levels to explore, a secret zone to find, an upgrade tree to invest in and much more. Here are all the changes.

[b]Patchnotes:[/b]

- Added 2 New Level to Senzela Forest
- Added First Neural Dream Challenge
- Added Skilltree
- Added The CuPy Companion
- Added Bartender Shop To The Casino
- Added Characters & Dialog To The Casino
- Reworked Casino Roof
- Added A Travel Animation
- Added New Sound Effects
- Balance Changes
- Improved Cutscenes
- A lot of Bug Fixes & Visual Tweaks
And much more!

I hope you will enjoy the new content!

notes.title: Version 1.2 Out Now!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo!!!
We have reached over 5k downloads! I tried to get as much feedback as possible so here is version 1.2.
The patch includes a lot of quality of life improvements, important collision fixes as well as a complete rework of the blackjack minigame.
Try it out and let me know what you think!

[b]Patchnotes:[/b]

- Increased overall Weapon Damage
- Reworked Blackjack Minigame
- Fixed Collision Issues
- Added Settings to Pause Menu
- Added Indicator for Low Ammo State
- Reworked Tutorial
- Tweaked Visuals of some Objects + Levels + Cutscenes
